Players Committee errata-sheet slip (0 side) of [[He Is The Chosen One / He Will Bring Balance (Errata 6)]].

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Errata-122022.pdf Errata Sheet December 2022] (Players Committee), PDF built 19 December 2022. The slip is the image embedded in the PDF (transparent areas shown white) or, for sheets that draw their text over a background image, cut from the page rendered at 300 dpi.

Edits: none.
